newsitem.title: USA: Price Enterprises to split into 2 companies.
newsitem.headline: Price Enterprises to split into 2 companies.

text.p: Price Enterprises Inc said Wednesday it will restructure by splitting its real estate and merchandising businesses into two separate publicly-traded companies.

After the restructuring, Price Enterprises will consist of the real estate operations and will be positioned to convert into a real estate investment trust (REIT). The merchandising business, to be named PriceSmart, is expected to be distributed as a special dividend on August 29, or shortly thereafter.
The company said splitting into two will have strategic benefits for both divisions.
